title: Can you play together?
sub: Crossplay answers for 500+ games, checked against official sources.

title: Elden Ring Nightreign
sub: PS4 + PS5 together. Xbox One + Series X|S together. PC only with PC.

title: Minecraft
label: Yes (Bedrock)
sub: Bedrock plays across everything. Java only plays with Java.

title: It Takes Two
label: Crossplay arrives
sub: Only one of you needs to own it, thanks to the free Friend's Pass.

title: ARC Raiders
sub: Mixed-platform squads of three. Progress follows your Embark account.

title: Stardew Valley
label: Computers only
sub: Windows, Mac and Linux farm together. Consoles stay with their own kind.

title: Helldivers 2
sub: Squad up with friend codes. Progress doesn't carry between platforms.

title: Rocket League
label: Yes, everywhere
sub: Every platform, every mode, Ranked included. Link to Epic to share progress.
